opportunities.name: Time zone comparison + holidays lookup, then draft sync email
opportunities.description: Compare two cities in the timeanddate Time Zone Converter, look up holidays for the later city's country, and compose an email to ops with the offset and dates to avoid.
steps: Open Time Zones > Time Zone Converter
Search and add city B and note the hour offset
Select the country of city B and review holidays
Open new mail message, fill To, Subject 'Sync: A / B, Month', and a body with offset and dates to avoid

instances.values: New York / Berlin, Germany holidays, December; ops@example.com; 6 hours ahead, avoid Dec 25 and 26

opportunities.name: Company research (SEC EDGAR + Wikipedia) and account brief email
opportunities.description: For a given ticker, find the company on SEC EDGAR full-text search, filter filings to 10-K annual reports, look the company up on Wikipedia, and email a brief to a contact.
steps: On EDGAR search, type ticker in company field and pick the suggestion
Open the Form filter and select 10-K Annual report
Search the company on Wikipedia and open its article
Open new mail message, enter recipient, subject 'Account brief: Company (TICKER)', and body with HQ, employees, CEO and latest 10-K date
